meta.name: The Three Kinds of Faith
meta.outline: Verses 1–6: Arjuna's question, and the three kinds of faith; 7–10: three kinds of food; 11–13: three kinds of sacrifice; 14–19: discipline of body, speech and mind, and its three kinds; 20–22: three kinds of giving; 23–28: “Om Tat Sat”, and why nothing done without faith has value.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
words: those who set aside the guidance of the scriptures
is it goodness, or passion, or dullness
verses.tr: Arjuna asked: Krishna, what of those who set aside the guidance of the scriptures and yet worship with faith? Is their standing one of goodness, of passion or of dullness?

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु
words: in embodied beings it is born of their own nature
सात्त्विकी राजसी च एव तामसी च इति
of goodness, of passion and of dullness
verses.tr: Krishna said: The faith of people is of three kinds, born of their own nature: of goodness, of passion and of dullness. Hear about it.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः
words: everyone's faith follows their inner nature
a person is made of faith
whatever one's faith is, that is what one is
verses.tr: Everyone's faith follows their inner nature, Arjuna. A person is made of faith: whatever a person's faith is, that is what the person is.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: people of goodness worship the gods
people of passion worship yakshas and rakshasas
प्रेतान् भूत-गणान् च अन्ये यजन्ते तामसाः जनाः
the others, people of dullness, worship ghosts and spirits
verses.tr: People of goodness worship the gods. People of passion worship yakshas and rakshasas. The others, people of dullness, worship ghosts and spirits.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः
words: harsh disciplines not taught in the scriptures
driven by the force of desire and attachment
verses.tr: People who practise harsh disciplines not taught in the scriptures, out of pretence and ego, driven by the force of desire and attachment,

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: torturing the elements of the body
and me too, who live within the body
know them to be demonic in their resolve
verses.tr: who senselessly torture the elements of the body, and me too, who live within the body: know them to be demonic in their resolve.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: आहारः तु अपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधः भवति प्रियः
the food that each person likes is also of three kinds
and so are sacrifice, discipline and giving
verses.tr: The food that people like is also of three kinds, and so are sacrifice, self-discipline and giving. Hear how they differ.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
words: which increase life, energy, strength, health, happiness and satisfaction
nourishing and pleasing to the heart
such foods are dear to people of goodness
verses.tr: Foods that increase life, energy, strength, health, happiness and satisfaction, and that are juicy, smooth, nourishing and pleasing, are dear to people of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: bitter, sour, salty, very hot, sharp, dry and burning
such foods are liked by people of passion
they bring pain, sorrow and illness
verses.tr: Foods that are bitter, sour, salty, very hot, sharp, dry and burning are liked by people of passion. They bring pain, sorrow and illness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्
words: such food is dear to people of dullness
verses.tr: Food that is stale, tasteless, rotten or left overnight, the leavings of others and what is impure, is dear to people of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: by those who want no reward
the sacrifice that is offered as the scriptures teach
with the mind settled that “this ought to be offered”
verses.tr: A sacrifice offered as the scriptures teach, by people who want no reward and whose minds are settled on the thought that it simply ought to be offered, is of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
words: but with a reward in view
दम्भ-अर्थम् अपि च एव यत् इज्यते
or what is offered for show
know that sacrifice to be of passion
verses.tr: But a sacrifice offered with a reward in view, or for show, Arjuna, know to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: A sacrifice that does not follow the scriptures, in which no food is given out, no mantras are chanted and no gifts are given, and which is empty of faith, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: honouring the gods, the brahmins, teachers and the wise
this is called discipline of the body
verses.tr: Honouring the gods, the brahmins, teachers and the wise; purity, honesty, self-restraint and non-violence: this is called the discipline of the body.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्
words: that is true, pleasant and helpful
and the regular study of the scriptures
this is called discipline of speech
verses.tr: Speech that does not hurt, that is true, pleasant and helpful, and the regular study of the scriptures: this is called the discipline of speech.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this is called discipline of the mind
verses.tr: Calmness of mind, gentleness, silence, self-control and purity of heart: this is called the discipline of the mind.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपः तत् त्रिविधम्
that threefold discipline, practised with the highest faith
by steady people who want no reward
is said to be of goodness
verses.tr: This threefold discipline, practised with the highest faith by steady people who want no reward, is said to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: for the sake of respect, honour and worship
तपः दम्भेन च एव यत् क्रियते
discipline that is practised for show
that is said here to be of passion
verses.tr: Discipline practised for show, to gain respect, honour and worship, is said to be of passion. It is unsteady and does not last.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: or in order to harm another
that is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: Discipline practised from a foolish idea, by torturing oneself or in order to harm another, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
words: a gift given because it is right to give
to one who can do nothing in return
at the right place and time, to a worthy person
that gift is held to be of goodness
verses.tr: A gift given because it is right to give, to someone who can do nothing in return, at the right place and time and to a worthy person, is held to be of goodness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
words: but what is given for a favour in return
or with a reward in view
that gift is held to be of passion
verses.tr: But a gift given in the hope of a favour in return, or with a reward in view, or given unwillingly, is held to be of passion.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: a gift at the wrong place and time
that is said to be of dullness
verses.tr: A gift given at the wrong place and time, to unworthy people, without respect and with contempt, is said to be of dullness.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: this is held to be the threefold name of Brahman
ब्राह्मणाः तेन वेदाः च यज्ञाः च
by it the brahmins, the Vedas and the sacrifices
verses.tr: “Om Tat Sat” is held to be the threefold name of Brahman. By it the brahmins, the Vedas and the sacrifices were created long ago.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: acts of sacrifice, giving and discipline
taught in the scriptures, are begun
always, by those who follow the Vedas
verses.tr: So those who follow the Vedas always say “Om” before they begin the acts of sacrifice, giving and discipline taught in the scriptures.

verses.speaker: Krishna
words: and the various acts of giving
are done by those who seek freedom
verses.tr: Saying “Tat”, and without aiming at any reward, those who seek freedom perform their acts of sacrifice, discipline and giving.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
words: for what is real and for what is good
and also for a praiseworthy action
verses.tr: The word “Sat” is used for what is real and for what is good. It is also used, Arjuna, for a praiseworthy action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते
words: steadiness in sacrifice, discipline and giving
and action done for that purpose
verses.tr: Steadiness in sacrifice, discipline and giving is also called “Sat”, and so is any action done for their sake.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
words: whatever is offered or given without faith
whatever discipline is practised and whatever is done
न च तत् प्रेत्य नो इह
it is worth nothing after death or here
verses.tr: Whatever is offered, given, practised or done without faith is called “Asat”, unreal, Arjuna. It is worth nothing, in this world or after death.
